questions.text: भुगतान संतुलन के चालू खाते लेनदेन के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित में से असत्य कथन की पहचान करें :
questions.text_english: In the context of Current Account transactions of Balance of Payment, identify the incorrect statement from the following:

options.A: वस्तुओं और सेवाओं के निर्यात को क्रेडिट मदों के रूप में दर्ज किया जाता है।
options.B: वस्तुओं और सेवाओं के आयात को डेबिट मदों के रूप में दर्ज किया जाता है।
options.C: सभी हस्तांतरण भुगतान डेबिट मदों के रूप में दर्ज किए जाते हैं।
options.D: सभी हस्तांतरण प्राप्तियाँ डेबिट मदों के रूप में दर्ज की जाती हैं।

options_english.A: Export of goods and services are recorded as credit items.
options_english.B: Import of goods and services are recorded as debit items.
options_english.C: All transfer payments are recorded as debit items.
options_english.D: All transfer receipts are recorded as debit items.

questions.solution: Option D is incorrect because transfer receipts represent an inflow of foreign exchange and are recorded as credit items, not debit items. Options A, B, and C correctly describe standard accounting entries for the current account.

questions.text: कॉलम-I व कॉलम-II में दी गई मदों में से सही युग्म का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english: From the items given in Column-I and Column-II, choose the correct pair.
questions.solution: Option B is correct because income from entrepreneurship is profit. Other pairs are incorrect: (a) should match with interest/rent/profit (property income), (c) is mixed income, and (d) is compensation of employees.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन करें : कथन 1: प्रबंधित तिरती विनिमय दर प्रणाली स्थिर व नम्य विनिमय दर प्रणाली का एक समामेलन है। कथन 2 : प्रबंधित तिरती विनिमय दर प्रणाली को 'हाईब्रिड प्रणाली' के रूप में भी जाना जाता है।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements carefully: Statement-1 : Managed floating exchange rate system is an amalgamation of fixed and flexible exchange rate system. Statement-2: Managed floating exchange rate system is also known as 'hybrid system'.
questions.instruction_line: दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: In the light of the given statements, choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Both statements are correct. The managed floating system combines features of fixed and flexible regimes, hence it is frequently referred to as a hybrid system.

questions.text: "इरफान (एक छात्र) ने अपनी कॉलेज की फीस के लिए ₹ 80,000 का ऋण लिया है। वह स्नातक होने के छह माह बाद ऋण चुकाना प्रारंभ करने की योजना बना रहा है, जिसे वह 10 वर्ष की अवधि में चुकाएगा।" उपरोक्त गद्य के आधार पर मुद्रा के निर्दिष्ट कार्य की पहचान करें।
questions.text_english: "Irfaan (a student) borrows ₹80,000 to finance his college fees. He plans to begin repaying the loan six months after graduation and will repay it over a period of ten years." Based on the above text, identify the indicated function of money.
questions.solution: Option C is correct because the function of money as a 'standard of deferred payments' allows for debts and credit transactions to be settled at a future date.

questions.text: मान लीजिए, किसी अर्थव्यवस्था का बचत वक्र ₹ 50 करोड़ के ऋणात्मक मूल्य पर अवरोध (intercept) बनता है। अर्थव्यवस्था में, आय में वृद्धि का 20% बचत के रूप में रखा जाता है। उपरोक्त संदर्भ के आलोक में, निवेश गुणक (K) के मूल्य की पहचान करें।
questions.text_english: Suppose, the saving curve of an economy makes an intercept at a negative value of 50 crores. In the economy, 20% of an increase in income is saved. In the light of above context, identify the value of investment multiplier (K).
questions.solution: The marginal propensity to save (MPS) is 20% or 0.2. The formula for the investment multiplier is $K = 1 / MPS$. Therefore, $K = 1 / 0.2 = 5$.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों अभिकथन (A) व कारण (R) का अध्ययन करें। अभिकथन (A) : सार्वजनिक वस्तुएँ वे वस्तुएँ हैं, जिनका उपभोग जनता द्वारा सामूहिक रूप से किया जाता है। कारण (R) : सार्वजनिक वस्तुएँ बहिष्कृत एवं प्रतिद्वन्द्वात्मक प्रकृति की होती हैं।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements: Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Assertion (A): Public goods are those goods that are collectively consumed by the public. Reason (R): Public goods are excludable and rivalrous in nature.
questions.instruction_line: नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन करें :
questions.instruction_line_english: Choose the correct option from those given below :

options.A: अभिकथन (A) व कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) व कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A) is true as public goods are collectively consumed. Reason (R) is false because public goods are non-excludable and non-rivalrous in nature, not excludable and rivalrous.

questions.text: मान लीजिए, औसत उपभोग प्रवृत्ति (APC) का मूल्य 0.8 है तथा राष्ट्रीय आय ₹ 4,000 करोड़ है, तो बचत का मूल्य ₹ _______ करोड़ होगा ।
questions.text_english: Suppose, the value of Average Propensity to Consume (APC) is 0.8 and National Income is 4,000 crores, the value of saving would be _______ crores.
questions.instruction_line: सही विकल्प द्वारा रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति करें ।
questions.instruction_line_english: Choose the correct option to fill up the blank
questions.solution: Consumption (C) is calculated as APC × Y, so 0.8 × 4000 = 3200 crores. Since Income (Y) = Consumption (C) + Saving (S), then Saving = 4000 - 3200 = 800 crores. The corrected sentence is: The value of saving would be 800 crores.

questions.text: वाणिज्यिक बैंकों के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन से कथन सत्य हैं ? (I) बैंकों के लिए जमाएँ देनदारियाँ होती हैं। (II) वे अर्थव्यवस्था में साख सृजक होते हैं। (III) वे आम जनता से जमा स्वीकार करते हैं। (IV) वे भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक की ओर से जमा स्वीकार करते हैं।
questions.text_english: In the context of the Commercial Banks, which of the following statements are correct? (I) Deposits received are liabilities for Commercial Banks. (II) They are creator of credit in the economy. (III) They accept deposits from general public. (IV) They accept deposits on behalf of Reserve Bank of India.
questions.solution: Statements (I), (II), and (III) are correct. Commercial banks treat deposits as liabilities, create credit, and accept deposits from the general public. Statement (IV) is incorrect as commercial banks do not accept deposits on behalf of the RBI.

questions.text: यदि कोई राष्ट्र ₹ 600 करोड़ का माल निर्यात करता है तथा ₹ 450 करोड़ का माल आयात करता है, तो राष्ट्र के व्यापार संतुलन का मूल्य ₹ _______ करोड़ का _______ होगा ।
questions.text_english: If a country exports goods worth of 600 crores and imports goods worth of 450 crores, the value of Balance of Trade of the country would be _______ crores of ***.
questions.solution: Balance of Trade (BOT) = Exports - Imports = 600 - 450 = 150 crores. Since exports exceed imports, it is a surplus of 150 crores.

questions.text: कॉलम-I व कॉलम-II में दिए गए पदों के समूह में से सही युग्म का चयन करें :

questions.solution: Option C is correct because capital expenditure typically includes loan repayments (borrowings/debt repayment). Other options are mismatched as GST is an indirect tax (b-i), non-tax revenue is not a free-rider (a-ii), and private goods are excludable (d-iv).

questions.text: (a) साधन लागत पर शुद्ध मूल्य वृद्धि (NVA_FC) के मूल्य की गणना करें:
questions.text_english: (a) Calculate the value of Net Value Added at Factor Cost (NVA_FC):

sub_questions.text: (i) परिचालन अधिशेष: 3,740, (ii) रहतिया में वृद्धि: 600, (iii) बिक्री: 10,625, (iv) कच्चे माल का क्रय: 2,625, (v) स्थायी पूँजी का उपभोग: 500, (vi) उपदान: 400, (vii) अप्रत्यक्ष कर: 1,200 (सभी आंकड़े ₹ करोड़ में)
sub_questions.text_english: (i) Operating Surplus: 3,740, (ii) Increase in unsold stock: 600, (iii) Sales: 10,625, (iv) Purchase of raw materials: 2,625, (v) Consumption of fixed capital: 500, (vi) Subsidies: 400, (vii) Indirect taxes: 1,200 (all in ₹ crores)

key_points: Gross Value Added at Market Price (GVA_MP) = Sales + Increase in stock - Purchase of raw materials
NVA_FC = GVA_MP - Depreciation - Indirect Taxes + Subsidies = 8600 - 500 - 1200 + 400 = 7300

sub_questions.solution: First, calculate Gross Value Added at Market Price (GVA_MP) by summing Sales and Increase in stock, then subtracting purchase of raw materials. This equals 10625 + 600 - 2625, resulting in 8600. To find NVA_FC, subtract depreciation (Consumption of fixed capital) of 500, subtract net indirect taxes (1200 - 400 = 800). Thus, NVA_FC = 8600 - 500 - 800 = 7300 crores.

questions.text: "सरकार ने देश के विभिन्न भागों में पर्यटन को प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए 'अतुल्य भारत' अभियान प्रारंभ किया था।" उपरोक्त अभियान के भारतीय विदेशी मुद्रा भंडार तथा भुगतान संतुलन पर पड़ने वाले प्रभावों को विस्तार से उल्लेखित करें।
questions.text_english: "The Government had launched the Incredible India Campaign to promote tourism in various parts of the country." Elaborate on the impact of this campaign on India's foreign exchange reserves and Balance of Payments.

key_points: Promotes tourism, leading to increased inflow of foreign currency.
Boosts the credit side of the current account in the Balance of Payments.
Increases foreign exchange reserves due to higher service exports.

questions.solution: The 'Incredible India' campaign promotes tourism, which significantly increases the number of foreign tourists visiting India. This leads to higher inflow of foreign currencies as service exports, strengthening India's foreign exchange reserves. In the Balance of Payments, this enhances the credit side of the current account, improving the overall balance position.

questions.text: "आयुष्मान भारत योजना के अंतर्गत सरकार समाज के निर्धन वर्ग को निःशुल्क चिकित्सा उपचार उपलब्ध कराती है।" उपरोक्त कथन में इंगित बजट व्यय की प्रकृति व उसके उद्देश्य की पहचान व व्याख्या करें।
questions.text_english: "Under the Ayushman Bharat Scheme, the government provides free medical treatment to the poorer sections of society." Identify and explain the nature of the budget expenditure and its objective indicated in the given statement.

key_points: Expenditure nature: Revenue expenditure (social sector welfare).
Objective: Reducing inequalities and providing social welfare.
Explanation: Direct intervention to support economically weaker sections.

questions.solution: The expenditure under the Ayushman Bharat scheme is a revenue expenditure because it is for providing services and does not create any tangible capital assets for the government. The primary objective of this expenditure is social welfare and the reduction of economic inequalities, as it facilitates access to essential medical care for the underprivileged sections of society.
questions.topic: Objectives and Classification of Budget Expenditure

questions.text: मान लीजिए, किसी अर्थव्यवस्था में प्राथमिक जमा ₹ 500 है, यदि आरक्षित अनुपात 25% है। बैंकिंग प्रणाली द्वारा सृजित कुल जमा राशियों तथा कुल उधार (ऋण) का अनुमान लगाएँ ।
questions.text_english: Suppose in an economy, primary deposits are 500, if the Reserve Ratio is 25%. Estimate the total deposits created and the total lending by the banking system.

key_points: Total Deposits = Primary Deposits × Money Multiplier = 500 × 4 = 2000
Total Lending = Total Deposits - Primary Deposits = 2000 - 500 = 1500

questions.solution: The money multiplier is calculated as 1 divided by the Legal Reserve Ratio (LRR), which is 1 / 0.25 = 4. The total deposits created by the banking system are calculated as primary deposits multiplied by the money multiplier, resulting in 500 × 4 = 2000. Total lending by the banking system is the difference between total deposits and initial primary deposits, which equals 1500.

questions.text: (a) एक अर्थव्यवस्था में; C=200+0.75 Y (जहाँ C= उपभोग व्यय है, तथा Y= राष्ट्रीय आय है) निवेश व्यय = ₹ 4,000 करोड़ है। निम्नलिखित की गणना करें : (i) आय का संतुलन स्तर (ii) आय के संतुलन स्तर पर कुल उपभोग व्यय
questions.text_english: (a) In an economy; C=200+0.75 Y (where C is consumption expenditure and Y is National Income). Investment expenditure is 4,000 Crore. Calculate the following: (i) Equilibrium level of income. (ii) Total consumption expenditure at equilibrium income level.
questions.solution: The equilibrium level of income occurs when aggregate demand equals aggregate supply (Y = C + I). Substituting the given values: Y = 200 + 0.75Y + 4000. Solving for Y, 0.25Y = 4200, which gives Y = 16800 crores. At this equilibrium income level, total consumption expenditure is calculated by C = 200 + 0.75(16800), which equals 12800 crores.

questions.text:
केन्द्रीय खाद्य व उपभोक्ता मामले के मंत्री ने कहा कि, सरकार ने खाद्य वस्तुओं की खुदरा (retail) कीमतों को नियंत्रित करने के लिए विगत वर्षों में कई सक्रिय कदम उठाए हैं। उन्होंने कहा कि, सरकार का लक्ष्य राष्ट्र की आर्थिक वृद्धि से समझौता किए बिना मुद्रास्फीति को नियंत्रण में रखना है। नवंबर 2023 में खुदरा मुद्रास्फीति 5.55% के तीन माह के उच्चतम स्तर पर पहुँच गई, जो कि खाद्य पदार्थों की बढ़ती कीमतों के कारण है। अगस्त 2023 में मुद्रास्फीति में गिरावट आयी थी, जब यह 6.83% पर पहुँच गई थी । आवश्यक वस्तुओं की थोक (wholesale) व खुदरा (retail) मूल्यों पर कड़ी निगरानी रखने हेतु केन्द्र सरकार ने 140 नए मूल्य निगरानी केन्द्र स्थापित किए हैं।

सरकार ने गेहूँ, टूटे चावल, गैर-बासमती सफेद चावल, प्याज आदि कई खाद्य पदार्थों के निर्यात पर प्रतिबंध लगा दिया है। घरेलू आपूर्ति को प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए तथा मूल्य वृद्धि को नियंत्रित करने के लिए सरकार ने तिलहन व दलहन पर आयात शुल्क भी कम कर दिया है।
questions.text_english:
Union Food and Consumer Affairs Minister said that the Central Government has taken many proactive steps in the past few years to control retail prices of food items. He said that the government aims to keep inflation under control without compromising the country's economic growth. Retail inflation inched up to a three-month high of 5.55% in November 2023 driven by higher food prices. Inflation has been declining since August 2023, when it touched 6.83%. 140 new price monitoring centres had been set up by the Central Government to keep a close watch on wholesale and retail prices of essential commodities.

The Government has banned the export of many food items like wheat, broken rice, non-basmati white rice, onions etc. It has also reduced import duties on edible oils and pulses to boost domestic supply and control price rise.
questions.instruction_line: उपरोक्त गद्य व सामान्य ज्ञान के आधार पर निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें :
questions.instruction_line_english: On the basis of the given text and common understanding, answer the following questions:

sub_questions.text: सरकार द्वारा स्थापित नए मूल्य निगरानी केन्द्रों की संख्या बताएँ ।
sub_questions.text_english: Mention the number of new price monitoring centres set up by government.
sub_questions.solution: The government has established 140 new price monitoring centres to keep a close watch on essential commodity prices.

sub_questions.text: घरेलू आपूर्ति को प्रोत्साहित करने व मूल्यों में कमी लाने के लिए सरकार द्वारा उठाए गए किन्हीं दो सक्रिय उपायों का उल्लेख करें ।
sub_questions.text_english: State any two proactive measures taken by government to boost domestic supply and reduction in prices.

key_points: Reducing import duties on items like pulses and edible oils.

sub_questions.solution: Two proactive measures taken by the government include banning the export of essential food items like wheat, rice, and onions, and reducing import duties on edible oils and pulses to increase domestic availability.

sub_questions.text: मुद्रास्फीति को नियंत्रित करने के लिए प्रयुक्त किसी एक मौद्रिक उपाय की व्याख्या करें।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain any one monetary measure used to control inflation.
sub_questions.solution: A common monetary measure is increasing the Repo Rate. When the central bank raises the Repo Rate, commercial banks increase their lending rates, which makes borrowing costlier for the public. This reduces investment and consumption demand, ultimately leading to a decrease in aggregate demand and curbing inflationary pressures.

questions.text: (a) (i) व्यय विधि द्वारा राष्ट्रीय आय की गणना करते समय अपनाई जाने वाली किन्हीं दो सावधानियों की व्याख्या करें। (ii) "उच्च सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) का अर्थ सदैव अर्थव्यवस्था में वस्तुओं की प्रति व्यक्ति अधि-उपलब्धता होता है।" उपरोक्त कथन का उस देश के लोगों के कल्याण के सूचकांक के रूप में समर्थन अथवा खंडन करें।
questions.text_english: (a) (i) Explain any two precautions to be adopted while estimating National Income by the Expenditure Method. (ii) "Higher Gross Domestic Product (GDP) always means higher per capita availability of goods in the economy." Defend or refute the given statement as an index of the welfare of the people of that country.

key_points: Precautions: Avoid expenditure on second-hand goods; exclude transfer payments.
Statement Refutation: GDP does not account for income distribution.
GDP ignores negative externalities like pollution.
GDP does not measure quality of life or per capita distribution.

questions.solution: When using the expenditure method, two precautions are: 1) exclude expenditure on second-hand goods as they are not part of current year's production, and 2) exclude transfer payments like scholarships or pensions as they do not generate productive output. The statement is refuted because high GDP does not necessarily imply higher welfare. GDP fails to account for the uneven distribution of income, negative externalities like environmental degradation, and the composition of goods produced, which may not always improve the quality of life for the average citizen.

questions.text: चीन में ग्रेट लीप फॉरवर्ड का प्राथमिक केन्द्र _______ क्षेत्रक था ।
questions.text_english: *** sector was the primary focus of the Great Leap Forward in China.
questions.instruction_line: सही विकल्प द्वारा रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति करें ।
questions.instruction_line_english: Fill up the blank with correct option
questions.solution: The Great Leap Forward (GLF) campaign in China primarily focused on rapid industrialization through the establishment of small-scale industries like backyard furnaces. Thus, the correct word is Industrial.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित चित्र का अध्ययन करें : उन विगत घटनाओं की पहचान व चयन करें, जिनमें संसाधनों की माँग उनकी आपूर्ति से अधिक हो गई है।
questions.text_english: Study the following picture: Identify and select, the recent phenomenon in which demand for resources surpasses their supply.
questions.solution: The picture depicts an industrial city with significant air pollution and smog. This corresponds to an 'environmental crisis', where the consumption and demand for natural resources and energy exceed the regenerative capacity or sustainable supply limits of the environment.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन करें : कथन-1 : कार्यरत व्यक्ति नियमित वेतनभोगी कर्मचारी या आकस्मिक कर्मचारी हो सकते हैं। कथन-2 : भारत के ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में नियमित वेतनभोगी रोज़गारी रोज़गार का एक प्रमुख स्रोत है।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements carefully: Statement-1: Hired workers may be regular salaried workers or casual workers. Statement-2: Regular salaried employment is a major source of employment in rural areas in India.
questions.instruction_line: दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: In the light of the given statements, choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Statement 1 is true because hired workers are classified into regular salaried and casual categories. Statement 2 is false as self-employment and casual labor are dominant in rural areas, while regular salaried employment is more prevalent in urban areas.

questions.text: नीचे दिए गए कॉलम-I व कॉलम-II में दिए गए पदों में से सही युग्म का चयन करें :

questions.text_english: "It is short-term unemployment occurring as people transit between jobs." On the basis of the given definition, identify the type of unemployment indicated.
questions.solution: Frictional unemployment is defined as short-term unemployment occurring when workers are in the process of transitioning or moving between jobs.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों अभिकथन (A) व कारण (R) का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन करें। अभिकथन (A): आर्थिक सुधारों से पूर्व, चीन द्वारा सामाजिक संरचना पर सार्वजनिक निवेश के परिणामस्वरूप बेहतर मानव विकास संकेतक (HDI) प्राप्त हुए थे । कारण (R) : चीन कई मानव विकास संकेतकों (HDI) में भारत व पाकिस्तान से आगे है।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements carefully: Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Assertion (A): Prior to economic reforms, public investment in social infrastructure by China resulted in better Human Development Indicators (HDI). Reason (R): China is ahead of India and Pakistan on many Human Development Indicators (HDI).
questions.instruction_line: नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन करें :

options.A: अभिकथन (A) व कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) व कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है।

questions.solution: Both statements are true. China's early focus on public health and education (social infrastructure) provided a strong foundation for its human development, explaining why it currently performs better than India and Pakistan on HDI metrics.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित चित्र का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन करें : उस व्यापार पद्धति की पहचान करें, जिसने विदेशी वस्तुओं को घरेलू उत्पादन से सफलतापूर्वक प्रतिस्थापित कर दिया है।
questions.text_english: Study the following image carefully: Identify, the trade practice that has successfully replaced foreign goods with domestic production.
questions.solution: Import substitution is the trade and economic policy which advocates replacing foreign imports with domestic production, as depicted in the cartoon where imports are being restricted to favor local industry.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों अभिकथन (A) व कारण (R) का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन करें। अभिकथन (A): मानव पूँजी निर्माण आर्थिक गतिविधियों में जनसंख्या की भागीदारी दर में वृद्धि करता है तथा आर्थिक विकास को प्रोत्साहित करता है। कारण (R) : भागीदारी दर किसी राष्ट्र की उत्पादन प्रक्रिया में संलग्न व्यक्तियों के प्रतिशत को संदर्भित करती है।

options.B: अभिकथन (A) व कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).

questions.text: भारत निम्नलिखित में से किस क्षेत्रीय / वैश्विक आर्थिक समूह का सदस्य नहीं है ?
questions.text_english: India is NOT a member of which of the following regional/global economic grouping?
questions.solution: India is a member of BRICS, SAARC, and G-20, but it is not a member of the G-7.
questions.chapter: Comparative Development Experience of India and its Neighbours

questions.text: (a) "विगत समयावधि में सहकारी समितियों को झटका लगा है।" उपरोक्त कथन का वैध स्पष्टीकरण द्वारा औचित्य सिद्ध करें।
questions.text_english: (a) "Cooperatives have received a setback during the recent past." Justify the given statement with a valid explanation.

key_points: Inability to compete with large private players.

questions.solution: Cooperatives have faced setbacks due to multiple reasons, including inefficient professional management, heavy reliance on government subsidies and support, and an inability to compete with technologically advanced private agribusinesses. These factors have undermined their sustainability and outreach to farmers.

questions.text: मानव पूँजी व आर्थिक विकास के मध्य संबंध स्थापित करें ।
questions.text_english: Trace the relationship between Human capital and Economic growth.

key_points: Higher growth translates into more resources for human development.

questions.solution: Human capital and economic growth have a bidirectional relationship. Investing in education and healthcare creates a skilled workforce, which increases labor productivity and innovation, thereby driving economic growth. Conversely, sustained economic growth provides more resources for countries to invest back into education and health, further enhancing human capital.

questions.text: (a) "जैव कीटनाशक हरित क्रांति के मृदा व जल निकायों पर दुष्प्रभावों को सीमित करने में सहायता करते हैं तथा धारणीय विकास को प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।" उपरोक्त कथन का वैध स्पष्टीकरण द्वारा औचित्य सिद्ध करें । (b) अवशोषण क्षमता को परिभाषित करें ।
questions.text_english: (a) "Bio-pesticides help to reduce the ill-impacts of green revolution on soil and water bodies while promoting sustainable development." Justify the given statement with valid explanation. (b) Define Absorptive capacity.
questions.solution: Bio-pesticides are natural, biodegradable alternatives to synthetic chemicals that caused soil degradation and water pollution during the Green Revolution. By reducing chemical runoff, they protect biodiversity and promote sustainability. Absorptive capacity is defined as the environment's ability to absorb or process waste products and pollution without experiencing permanent damage.

questions.text: (a) भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था के योजना उद्देश्य के रूप में 'आत्म निर्भरता' के चयन के पीछे के तर्कों का संक्षिप्त वर्णन करें ।
questions.text_english: (a) Describe briefly a rationale behind choosing 'Self-reliance' as a planning objective for the Indian economy.
questions.solution: Self-reliance was chosen as a planning objective to reduce India's dependence on foreign countries for essential goods and financial aid, especially in the post-colonial period. The rationale was to ensure national sovereignty and avoid political or economic interference from foreign powers, while simultaneously providing the necessary impetus for domestic industries to grow and achieve technological self-sufficiency.

questions.text: पाकिस्तान द्वारा अपने आर्थिक विकास पथ के लिए उठाए गए विकासात्मक कदमों का वर्णन करें ।
questions.text_english: Describe the path of developmental initiatives taken by Pakistan for its economic development.
questions.solution: Pakistan adopted a mixed economy model early on, with a significant regulatory framework in the 1950s and 1960s. During the 1970s, it shifted toward nationalization of major industries. However, from the 1980s onwards, the policy orientation moved toward denationalization, private sector encouragement, and various liberalization measures aimed at enhancing economic competitiveness, though progress has remained volatile due to political and external factors.
questions.chapter: Comparative Development Experience of India and its Neighbours

questions.text: (a) मान्य कारणों द्वारा उल्लेखित करें कि, निम्नलिखित कथन सत्य है अथवा असत्य : (i) औपनिवेशिक शासन में भारत में असंतुलित विकास हुआ था । (ii) 1950 से 1990 के मध्य भारत में लागू की गई आर्थिक नीतियों का उद्देश्य क्षेत्रीय समानता को प्रोत्साहित करना था । (iii) 1991 के उपरांत की अवधि में भारत बाह्य प्रापण (outsourcing) के लिए एक अनुकूल स्थान बन गया ।
questions.text_english: (a) Giving valid reasons, state whether the following statements are true or false. (i) India followed unbalanced growth during the colonial rule. (ii) The economic policies implemented in India between 1950 1990's sought to promote regional equality. (iii) India has become a favourable destination of outsourcing, in post 1991 period.

key_points: (i) True: Exploitation for raw materials only.
(ii) True: Balanced regional development as a goal.
(iii) True: Availability of low-cost skilled labour.

questions.solution: (i) True: During colonial rule, the economy was exploited to export raw materials and import finished goods, leading to de-industrialization and an unbalanced structure. (ii) True: Five-year plans emphasized balanced regional development to reduce regional disparities. (iii) True: Post-1991 liberalization and access to low-cost, English-speaking skilled professionals made India a top hub for global outsourcing.
questions.chapter: Indian Economy on the Eve of Independence / Indian Economy (1950-1990) / Liberalisation, Privatisation and Globalisation

questions.text:
कृषि-स्टार्टअप व ग्रामीण उद्यम भारत में ग्रामीण विकास के लिए तीव्रता से महत्त्वपूर्ण होते जा रहे हैं। वे भारत में ग्रामीण क्षेत्र में आने वाली गंभीर चुनौतियों का समाधान प्रस्तुत करते हैं। ये उद्यम उन्नत कृषि, IT-आधारित निगरानी प्रणाली व डेटा आधारित निर्णय लेने वाले उपकरण जैसे तकनीकी नवाचार लाते हैं, जो उत्पादकता व संसाधन दक्षता में वृद्धि करते हैं।

आपूर्ति श्रृंखलाओं को सुव्यवस्थित करके व प्रत्यक्ष बाजार से संपर्क स्थापित करके वे कृषकों के लिए उचित मूल्य निर्धारण सुनिश्चित करते हैं तथा पारंपरिक बिचौलियों पर निर्भरता भी कम करते हैं। ऐसे उद्यम ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में रोजगार सृजन में सक्रिय रूप से योगदान प्रदान करते हैं। सरकार ने RKVY-RAFTAAR, कृषि अवसंरचना कोष तथा Agri-SURE आदि विभिन्न कार्यक्रमों के माध्यम से कृषि स्टार्टअपों व उद्यमियों के लिए निरंतर नीति व वित्तीय सहायता का प्रदर्शन किया है।
questions.text_english:
Agro-startups and rural enterprises are becoming increasingly vital for rural development in India. They address the critical challenges faced by rural sector in India. These ventures bring in technological innovations such as precision farming, IT-based monitoring system and data-driven decision making tools that enhance productivity and resource efficiency.

By streamlining supply chains and creating direct market linkages, they ensure better pricing for farmers and reduce dependency on traditional intermediaries. Such enterprises contribute actively to employment generation in the rural areas. The government has demonstrated a continuous policy and financial support for agri-startups and entrepreneurs through various programs like RKVY-RAFTAAR, the Agri-infrastructure fund and Agri-SURE.
questions.instruction_line: उपरोक्त गद्य व सामान्य ज्ञान के आधार पर निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दें :
questions.instruction_line_english: On the basis of given text and common understanding, answer the following questions:

sub_questions.text: उल्लेख करें कि किस प्रकार कृषि-स्टार्टअप कृषि क्षेत्र में आने वाली गंभीर चुनौतियों का समाधान प्रस्तुत करते हैं।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain, how agro-startups address the critical challenges faced by the agricultural sector.
sub_questions.solution: Agro-startups address critical agricultural challenges by introducing technological innovations like precision farming and IT-based monitoring systems, which boost productivity and resource efficiency. Additionally, they streamline supply chains and create direct market links, which reduce dependency on middlemen and ensure fairer prices for farmers.

sub_questions.text: भारत में कृषि स्टार्टअपों व उद्यमियों को समर्थन देने में सरकार की भूमिका पर टिप्पणी करें।
sub_questions.text_english: Comment on the role of government in supporting agro-startups and entrepreneurs in India.
sub_questions.solution: The government supports agri-startups by providing essential financial assistance and policy framework through programs such as RKVY-RAFTAAR, the Agri-Infrastructure Fund, and Agri-SURE.

questions.solution: Passage-based question set. Answers are provided in sub_questions.
